tools.name: preview_financials
tools.description: falcon.sol: Free: latest fiscal-year revenue and net income for a US ticker or CIK, from SEC EDGAR.

tools.name: suggest_peers
tools.description: falcon.sol: Free: SIC-based peer tickers for a US company, ranked by revenue closeness, ready to pass to get_comps.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: falcon.sol: Standardized financials (up to 15 FY + TTM, balance sheet, ratios, XBRL provenance) from SEC EDGAR. Costs $0.015 USDC (x402).

tools.name: get_comps
tools.description: falcon.sol: Trading comps table (market cap, EV, EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA, P/E, P/FCF, margins, peer medians) for up to 12 tickers. Costs $0.05 USDC (x402).

tools.name: get_credit
tools.description: falcon.sol: Lev-fin credit comps (leverage, coverage, FCF/debt, debt capacity, rated structures, memo) for up to 12 tickers. Costs $0.24 USDC (x402).

tools.name: get_lbo
tools.description: falcon.sol: LBO snapshot (sources & uses, 3 structures, IRR/MOIC, IRR grid, memo) for a US ticker, exit at peer-median EV/EBITDA. Costs $4.49 USDC (x402).

tools.name: get_gpu_comps
tools.description: falcon.sol: Listed USD per GPU-hour comps (RunPod, Modal, Lambda, CoreWeave public price pages) with source URLs, fetched_at, min/median/max and quote percentile. Costs $0.04 USDC (x402).
